items.title: 3.6.1 Kuch diatomic molecules ke molecular orbital diagrams aur un ke bond orders (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.6.1, printed pages 65-67.

blocks.text: He ki configuration 1s2 hai. He2 banne ke liye do helium atoms ke 1s orbitals ko bonding sigma 1s aur antibonding sigma* 1s orbital mein milna hoga. Chaar electrons mein se do bonding orbital mein aur baqi do antibonding orbital mein jate hain, to He2 ka bond order (2 - 2) / 2 = 0 hai; is liye He2 molecule nahi banta.

Nitrogen 1s2 2s2 2px1 2py1 2pz1 hai. Dono atoms ke valence 2s orbitals sigma 2s aur sigma* 2s dete hain, jabke 2p orbitals chhe molecular orbitals barhti energy ki tarteeb mein: sigma 2s < sigma* 2s < pi 2py = pi 2pz < sigma 2px < pi* 2py = pi* 2pz < sigma* 2px. N2 ka bond order us ke diagram se (6 - 0) / 2 = 3 hai, 2p electrons gin kar, to nitrogen atoms ke darmiyan teen covalent bonds hain, ek sigma aur do pi: triple bond.

Oxygen ke liye molecular orbitals ki energies sigma 2s < sigma* 2s < sigma 2px < pi 2py = pi 2pz < pi* 2py = pi* 2pz < sigma* 2px tarteeb mein hain. Oxygen ka bond order 2 hai, jo oxygen atoms ke darmiyan ek sigma aur ek pi bond dikhata hai, double bond O=O. Oxygen molecule paramagnetic hai: yeh maqnatisi maidan se khincha jata hai, aur maya (liquid) oxygen mazboot maqnatis ke qutbon ke darmiyan khinch kar latki rehti hai. Paramagnetic madde ek ya zyada ghair-jure electrons rakhte hain, aur bohat se ghair-jure electrons wala madda shadeed paramagnetic hota hai. MOT yeh rawaiya samjhati hai: oxygen ka MO diagram do ghair-jure electrons dikhata hai, pi* 2py aur pi* 2pz mein ek ek, jo molecule ko kul maqnatisi maidan dete hain jo bairooni maidan se taamul karta hai.

blocks.alt: Energy diagram. Har helium atom ke 1s orbital mein do electrons. Yeh mil kar neeche bonding orbital sigma 1s aur oopar antibonding orbital sigma* 1s banate hain, dono mein do do electrons. Dabbe mein bond order = (2 - 2) / 2 = 0, is liye He2 nahi banta.
blocks.caption: He2 molecule ka molecular orbital diagram (Figure 3.36 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: N2 ka energy diagram. Har nitrogen 2s2 2p3. Molecule mein neeche se: sigma 2s (2 electrons), sigma* 2s (2), do pi 2p orbitals (4), sigma 2px (2), phir khaali pi* 2p aur sigma* 2px. Bond order = (8 - 2) / 2 = 3, triple bond, sab electrons joron mein.
blocks.caption: N2 molecule ka molecular orbital diagram (Figure 3.37 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: O2 ka energy diagram. Har oxygen 2s2 2p4. Molecule mein neeche se: sigma 2s (2), sigma* 2s (2), sigma 2px (2), do pi 2p orbitals (4), phir har pi* 2p mein aik aik electron, aur sigma* 2px khaali. Bond order = (8 - 4) / 2 = 2; do akele electrons O2 ko paramagnetic banate hain.
blocks.caption: O2 molecule ka molecular orbital diagram (Figure 3.38 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: 2s electrons ginna
blocks.text: Har diagram mein do electrons sigma 2s aur do sigma* 2s mein bhi hain; woh cancel ho jate hain aur bond order nahi badalte, to print sirf 2p electrons ginti hai.

blocks.prompt: H2, He2, N2, O2 aur F2 ke bond orders nikalein, aur batayein ke in mein se kaun paramagnetic hai.
blocks.explanation: H2: do electrons sigma 1s mein, (2 - 0) / 2 = 1. He2: (2 - 2) / 2 = 0. N2: (6 - 0) / 2 = 3. O2: (6 - 2) / 2 = 2. F2: 2p set mein das electrons hain, chhe bonding aur chaar pi* orbitals mein, (6 - 4) / 2 = 1. Sirf O2 ke ghair-jure electrons hain, har pi* orbital mein ek, to sirf O2 paramagnetic hai.

items: He2: bond order 0, nahi banta. N2: pi 2py = pi 2pz < sigma 2px chhe electrons se bhare, bond order 3 (ek sigma, do pi). O2: sigma 2px < pi 2py = pi 2pz, phir pi* 2py aur pi* 2pz mein ek ek electron, bond order 2 aur paramagnetic.
